meta.title: Get Involved
meta.description: Pledge your support, volunteer, or share Sen. Hillary Sigei's campaign with someone in Bomet.

hero.title: Get involved
hero.lead: Three ways to help: pledge, volunteer, share. Each takes under a minute.

pledge.title: Pledge your support
pledge.lead: Tell us you are with Bomet. We will only use your details to update you about the campaign.
pledge.thanks: Asante sana! Your pledge is recorded.

volunteer.title: Volunteer
volunteer.lead: Help in your ward: talking to neighbours, organising meetings, getting people registered.
volunteer.thanks: Asante sana! We will be in touch about how you can help.

share.title: Share
share.lead: The most powerful campaign tool is you. Send this site to one person in Bomet today.
share.text: Sen. Wakili Hillary Sigei: Bomet's son. The work continues.
